pair_index_policy: At each observed time, draw ordered off-diagonal pairs with replacement. Draws are independent across time. One draw is shared across all spatial tests, temporal tests, and dictionary atoms for that time. Training and validation use separate pair seeds and therefore independent pair samples.
condition_budget_policy: Nominal, process-noise, and other N=500 conditions use P=5000. Particle-number conditions use P=10N. Pair-count conditions use the source protocol's declared P values at N=500.
selection_policy: Retain the source estimator unchanged. Each non-pair-count condition selects raw LASSO by its independent sampled validation weak residual. The pair-count sweep selects at nominal P=5000 and fixes that absolute alpha for every P. Truth and latent test metrics are excluded from fitting and selection.
source_preservation_policy: Copy model, dictionary, weak tests, sweep grids, estimator, seeds, evaluation settings, and observation-noise protocol from the authoritative 123949Z frozen protocol. Apart from preview metadata and R=2, alter only pair sampling budgets/mode and the pair-count penalty policy.
output_policy: Preview-only new timestamped output directory; do not modify the superseded 223853Z output, manuscript, current figures, or frozen scientific results.
